cards.text: Most of the spies who explored Canaan just came back with a bad report: strong people, fortified cities, people great in stature (Numbers 13:28-33). Friend, they came back sounding like they watched a scary movie with the lights off. Now the whole congregation cries out, and that night the people weep.

cards.question: The crying turns into grumbling against Moses and Aaron, Israel's leaders. What does the whole congregation say they wish had happened?

answers.text: That they had died in Egypt
That they had stayed at Mount Sinai
That they had picked different spies

cards.question: The people say the LORD is bringing them into this land to fall by the sword.

cards.text: They say their wives and children will become plunder, and they ask if it wouldn't be better to just go back to Egypt. Friend, that's like me begging to climb BACK into the junk drawer I spent years stuck in.

cards.question: So the people say to one another: let's appoint a new ___ and head back to Egypt.

cards.text: Moses and Aaron fall facedown before the whole assembly. Then two of the spies, Joshua son of Nun and Caleb son of Jephunneh, tear their clothes.

cards.question: Joshua and Caleb walked that land too. They tell the whole congregation it is an exceedingly ___ land.
Joshua and Caleb tell the people who will bring Israel into this land and give it to them. Who do they say it is?

cards.text: Then they say, "Only do not rebel against the LORD, and do not be afraid of the people of the land, for they will be like bread for us." The other spies said they felt like grasshoppers next to these folks (Numbers 13:33), and these two see BREAD.

cards.question: Joshua and Caleb tell the people that Israel's army is strong enough to win on its own.
That's the pep talk from Joshua and Caleb. How does the whole congregation respond to them?

answers.text: They ask to see the fruit

cards.text: And right then, the glory of the LORD appears to all the Israelites at the Tent of Meeting. I bet you could hear a sprinkle drop.

cards.question: The LORD asks Moses how long this people will refuse to ___ in Him, despite all the signs He has performed among them.

cards.text: Then the LORD says He will strike them with a plague and destroy them, and make Moses into a nation greater and mightier than they are. Plenty of folks would jump at that, so watch what Moses does.

cards.question: Moses answers the LORD. Who does Moses say will hear about it, since God brought this people out from among them?
Moses tells the LORD that the nations will say He was unable to bring this people into the land He swore to give them.

cards.text: So Moses prays, quoting what the LORD declared: "The LORD is slow to anger and abounding in loving devotion, forgiving iniquity and transgression." He quotes the other half too: the LORD will by no means leave the guilty unpunished.

cards.question: Then Moses asks the LORD to ___ the iniquity of this people, in keeping with the greatness of His loving devotion.
The LORD tells Moses He has pardoned the people as Moses requested.

cards.text: PARDONED, friend, go ahead and exhale. But then the LORD swears, as surely as He lives and as surely as the whole earth is filled with the glory of the LORD.

cards.question: These men saw God's glory and His signs in Egypt and the wilderness, and still tested Him ten times. What does the LORD say about them?

answers.text: None of them will see the land
They will lead the way in

cards.question: But the LORD singles out one man by name: My servant ___ has a different spirit and has followed Me wholeheartedly.

cards.text: The LORD says He will bring Caleb into the land he entered, and his descendants will inherit it. Then He gives directions for tomorrow, since the Amalekites, a people who once attacked Israel in the wilderness (Exodus 17:8), and the Canaanites, the people of the land of Canaan, are living in the valleys.

cards.question: The LORD tells Israel to turn back tomorrow and head for the wilderness along the route to the Red Sea.

cards.text: Then the LORD says to Moses and Aaron, "How long will this wicked congregation grumble against Me?" He has heard the complaints the Israelites are making against Him.

cards.question: The LORD tells Moses and Aaron what to say to the people. As surely as He lives, what does the LORD say He will do to them?

answers.text: Exactly what He heard them say
Lead them into the land at once
Let them rest at Kadesh awhile

cards.question: The LORD says only the spies who gave the bad report will fall in the wilderness.

cards.text: It's not just the spies, friend. It's EVERYBODY twenty years of age or older who was counted in the census, and none of them will enter the land except Caleb son of Jephunneh and Joshua son of Nun.

cards.question: So who does the LORD say He will bring into the land the people rejected?

cards.text: Think about that, friend: the children they said would become plunder are the ones who will enjoy the land. But first they'll be shepherds in the wilderness, suffering for their parents' unfaithfulness until the last of those bodies lies there.

cards.question: For each of the forty days the spies explored the land, the people will bear their guilt for one ___.

cards.text: The LORD says He has spoken, and He will surely do these things. Then the men who brought out the bad report about the land are struck down by a plague before the LORD.

cards.question: Of the men who went to spy out the land, only Joshua and Caleb remain alive.
Moses passes all this on, and the people mourn bitterly. Early the next morning they head up toward the ridge of the hill country. What are they trying to do now?

answers.text: Go to the place the LORD promised
Search the hills for fresh water
Bury the men from the plague

cards.text: They even say, "We have indeed sinned," but now they're going up. Friend, that's like hitting snooze nine times and then CHASING the bus after it already pulled away.

cards.question: But Moses asks why they're transgressing the LORD's commandment and says this will not succeed. Why does he say their enemies will strike them down?

answers.text: The LORD is not among them
Their army is far too small
The cities are too well fortified

cards.text: Moses warns that the Amalekites and Canaanites will face them there, and they will fall by the sword. But they dare to go up to the ridge anyway.

cards.question: When the people go up to the ridge, Moses and the ark of the covenant of the LORD go with them.
The Amalekites and Canaanites come down from the hill country, attack Israel, and rout them all the way to ___.
